card.title: Prophecy Under Revision
card.instruction: Project absolute certainty about what happens next while quietly revising the prophecy whenever reality disagrees.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Set our best plates out. A visitor wearing gold will bring us a fortune tonight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the plumber with brass fittings. I'll get his payment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Working gold. Leave the money; he'll be bringing ours.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: His bill's enormous. We owe him.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A fortune changing hands. Fetch the chequebook; once he leaves, we'll never have to pay a plumber again.

mechanism: A preserves a gold-and-fortune prophecy by redefining brass and then the direction in which money changes hands.
confusable: Unlike general optimism after setbacks, A must maintain the appearance of one correct prediction while revising its terms.
comparison: The plumber alternative changes the beneficiary of the fortune; the moon alternative relocates the predicted noon.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
